scenes.description: The majlis is empty; a small coffee cup is set down on a brass tray, the bottle glowing on the side table behind it.

shot.lighting: warm 2700K practical lamp camera-left, soft amber fill, deep shadows
shot.composition: cup in the foreground, the amber bottle soft in the background right
shot.subject_action: a hand sets a small coffee cup down on the brass tray
shot.setting: an empty majlis at night, cushions and a brass tray

scenes.description: At the door, the host turns back toward the last guest.

shot.lighting: tungsten hall light from above, warm rim on the shoulders
shot.composition: the host in a white thobe frames the right third, the doorway left
shot.subject_action: the host turns toward the guest at the doorway

scenes.description: He offers the bottle with both hands; the guest's hand reaches for it.

shot.lighting: warm practical key camera-left, gold rim on the cap
shot.composition: two hands and the bottle centred, the gold dome cap catching light
shot.subject_action: the host's two hands offer the amber bottle to the guest

scenes.description: The bottle alone on the brass tray, its gold cap catching the last light.

shot.lighting: one warm key from camera-left, soft fill, a thin gold rim
shot.composition: the bottle centred and upright, the lower fifth dark and empty for the end card
shot.subject_action: a slow push-in on the amber bottle
shot.setting: the brass tray in the empty majlis
